meta.title: Extensions — KB Labs
meta.description: Keep KB Labs CLI-first, then add Studio, MCP, or workflows only when they help your local development loop.

hero.title: Start small.
hero.description: The CLI is the base. Choose local capabilities when they are useful to your work, not because the platform requires them.

items.title: Studio
items.description: A local visual workspace for observing runs, logs, and plugin surfaces after you start the services.
items.note: Optional. The CLI remains fully usable without it.

items.title: MCP
items.description: Expose KB Labs tools to an MCP-compatible coding agent running on your machine.
items.note: Optional. Add it only when an agent needs this integration.

items.title: Workflows
items.description: Run repeatable multi-step automation when a single command grows into a durable process.
items.note: Optional. Start with a command and add a workflow when it earns its complexity.

cta.title: Choose extensions during setup.
cta.description: The launcher presents these capabilities as an optional page after you choose an outcome.
